record.question: According to the interim budget 2019-10 Rs. 6000 is allotted for every farmer through:
record.explanation: Answer C: PM- KISAN Programme. The interim Union Budget proposed PM-KISAN income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families. The printed budget year “2019-10” is a typographical error for 2019–20. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/budget2019-20%28I%29/ub2019-20/bs/bs.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
